evaluator.notes: Audited source/report and delivered packages reviewed.

session_selection.rationale: Single production root plus one descendant.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e55282a CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench with explicit external/header-only roots, 2 CPUs,3GiB,256 processes. Initial missing header-root configuration failed; CTest has no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case/output and solver options; documented run_all orchestration, not every error path independently exercised.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, physics, solver and IO modules are separated; fixed 2-D state limits extension.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy excludes external authorship search; no solver wrapper observed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp and case_config.cpp load case mesh and boundary settings; no two-mesh filename-only solver branch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor state exchange present; partition interfaces use only owned-side gradient and separately evaluated fluxes need not cancel.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Floors and trust-region updates exist; solver.cpp:1015–1019 declares convergence unconditionally at max steps, and residual target alone stops M2 laminar while force is changing.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Explicit validator and rank studies delivered; no CTests registered, and structural validation misses M2 laminar drift and partition-flux defect.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source/report modular and immutable snapshot includes report figures; raw result histories remain workspace evidence.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex equations and physics.cpp implement nondimensional conservative gas dynamics with case-scaled forces.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp reads triangle/quad sections, boundary families and declared abutting zone interfaces; general connectivities unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp face flux is locally conservative for owned pairs, but partition ghost side is unreconstructed and separately evaluated rank fluxes need not cancel.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.cpp implements Rusanov with low-Mach dissipation and optional HLLC; no independent shock convergence test.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall and boundary-state surface output implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ/BJ owned-cell reconstruction active; partition ghost side uses cell center, contrary to no first-order-fallback report claim.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: BJ/Venkat and positivity/trust safeguards implemented; production report says BJ. Limiter frozen inside transient inner solve.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Corrected gradients and Newtonian/Fourier flux; ghost-side viscous gradient is zero on rank boundaries; wall traction tangential projection present.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: SGS and CFL control exist; convergence test accepts target/max steps without checking stable forces and steady inner ratio uses update proxy.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 freezes accepted-state limiter through inner solve and tests that frozen residual; report discloses this, but fully refreshed target misses are unproven.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, state halo and reductions exist; missing ghost gradients mean separately computed partition fluxes need not cancel. Rank study has 1.3% Re20 Cd span and small absolute lift variation.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight layouts passed prior validator, which does not establish convergence; metadata reports M2 laminar converged prematurely.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit examiner invocation passed all eight required output packages and report; structural scope only.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar incorrectly marked converged despite Cd0.339895→0.167402 in final200; several below-target cases have independently bounded plateaus.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd1.993 and Re200 St~0.186 are plausible; M2 laminar is still changing, low-speed inviscid remains oscillatory, and high residuals warrant caution.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Report has case-specific fields and residuals; several common-scale force images flatten both late components and Re200 fails readable late drag floor.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Discloses limiter freezing and plateau limits but asserts no first-order fallback despite partition ghost issue, and calls M2 laminar converged despite large force drift.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Committed report figures and source; Re20 force, residual, Mach-zoom PNGs independently pixel-reproduced from named workspace inputs. Other image bindings and exact binary hash unverified.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean build and validator; CLI error paths not exhaustively exercised.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS TRI/QUAD, families, abutting zone merge and adjacency; general connectivity unsupported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: FV and walls implemented, but owner-only reconstruction at partition faces breaks guaranteed cancellation of independently computed rank fluxes.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ and BJ active, but ghost-side partition reconstruction absent and report no-fallback claim inaccurate.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Corrected gradients, stresses, wall conditions and tangential split; ghost-side viscous gradient omitted.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: SGS and BDF present; steady update-proxy stopping and BDF frozen-limiter target limit nonlinear convergence evidence.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, state halos and reductions present; missing gradient/limiter exchange makes partition-face fluxes inconsistent, despite reported small rank-study differences.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Two inviscid bounded plateaus, two laminar and Re20 bounded plateaus, Re200 periodic shedding and rank study; M2 laminar incorrectly marked converged and low-speed oscillation remains.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Complete case figures and methods, but partition no-fallback claim and M2 laminar convergence are inaccurate; late force views compressed.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate modules and case inputs but fixed 2-D state/geometry require substantive 3-D or multispecies refactoring.

flags.evidence: CMake builds submitted CFD source; no solver wrapper found.

flags.text: Force or residual files generated without solving
flags.evidence: Time march writes histories; no synthetic-history path established.
Case-configured mesh and boundary map are read generically.
Reported rankstudy Re20 tail Cd1.9677..1.9932 (~1.3%); low-speed lift differences ~0.017 absolute near zero, not order-one coefficient changes. Source interface defect warrants deductions.
SGS steady and BDF2 transient source implemented.

flags.text: Report claims algorithms absent from source
flags.evidence: Rusanov, BJ, SGS, BDF and METIS exist; partition interface defect is partial implementation and reporting limitation, not a wholly absent major algorithm.

flags.text: metadata/status marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
flags.evidence: Prior rationale treated six below-target results as automatically false success; this is withdrawn because bounded residual and stable-force plateau can qualify. Independently, M2 laminar metadata SHA256 2be9f6ef26942dd399a3f309091b1b56d1dbb8036c2e1e521180a91271970576 marks converged at 1386 despite force CSV SHA256 d4491fb52f42154ae0424d2dc4c46c7a98bbfe09c2f39d8653f651eabb60618a decreasing Cd0.339895→0.167402 in final200 and 0.198447→0.167402 in final50. Report e55282a:solver/report/results.tex:281 repeats convergence and 0.1674; real 3-order residual drop alone does not justify clear early laminar convergence under TASK.md:140,172. Other cases require separate review.

flags.text: Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
flags.evidence: Re20 force, residual and Mach-zoom originals pixel-reproduced from corresponding workspace CSV/VTU with immutable plotter; untested figures remain qualified.

flags.text: Metadata reports METIS but only geometric split or full-state replication
flags.evidence: METIS_PartGraphKway, rank0 global preprocessing, local ghost partitions and neighbor state exchange; global mesh discarded before iterations.

flags.text: Production second-order reconstruction or limiter disabled
flags.evidence: LSQ/BJ active for owned cells. Ghost side at each rank interface is first order, contradicting no-fallback claim and requiring deductions, but whole production reconstruction/limiter is not disabled.

flags.text: No-slip surface rows are undisclosed cell-center velocities
flags.evidence: solver.cpp:835 onward writes boundary-state zero wall velocity; report describes boundary values.
plot_results.py maps Mach and pressure fields by variable name; Re20 Mach reproduced; other figure bindings qualified.

flags.text: Copied or wrapped existing open-source solver core
flags.evidence: Trust policy excludes external authorship investigation; no internal solver wrapper identified.

limitations: No evaluator build or MPI rerun.
Structural validation does not prove convergence.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
